group.name: Wink
group.tagline: Japanese idol duo (1988–1996). Presentation-ready reference: all albums with tracklists & credits, all singles with B-sides, cover-song origins, album covers, and video links.
group.label: PolyStar | **Management**: Upright Music (1988–1994) → P-ARTISTS (1994–1996)
group.choreography: Igarashi Kaoruko (五十嵐薫子, now 香瑠鼓) — the famous "robot dance"
group.style: expressionless, doll-like performances; extravagant doll-inspired fashion; early hits were Japanese-language covers of European pop songs; later ~60% of their ~180 recorded songs were originals
group.awards: 31st Japan Record Award Grand Prix (1989, "Samishii Nettaigyo"); 40th Kōhaku Uta Gassen (1989); Japan Gold Disc Award (Twin Memories); 1989 All-Japan Cable Awards Grand Prix
group.chartLegacy: 5 Oricon #1 singles; 10 Top-3 singles; biggest album "Especially for You" (508,000 copies, Platinum)
group.reunions: Japan Record Awards specials (1998, 2008, 2018), NHK "Omoide no Melody" (2018); 30th-anniversary digital remasters & analog singles (2018)
group.note: Wink never officially disbanded — activities were "suspended" in 1996.
